papers.title: FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
papers.translated_title: FPTR：面向截止时间约束的联合波束与资源分配的可行性保持事务性精化
papers.author: Minghao Kong
papers.summary: Short-interval wireless schedulers must return a complete, feasible beam-and-resource allocation before each execution deadline, and a late or invalid output gives no utility in the current control cycle. Searching longer can increase transmitted traffic, but it may also miss the deadline or leave only an infeasible intermediate solution. We propose Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement (FPTR), which always keeps a validated feasible allocation, the incumbent. Each refinement stage builds a separate candidate and leaves the incumbent unchanged. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is complete, passes the feasibility validator before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective; otherwise it is discarded. Four refinement stages use this rule: buffer-aware resource selection, compatibility-group (CG) user sharing, beam-mask rebuilding from remaining demand, and joint reassignment of two resources. On 150 fixed synthetic instances, the full pipeline (Full) raises traffic by 3.83% on average over a lightweight beam-first reference and by 1.79% over its Base constructor. In a separate suite with matched inputs, Full exceeds six independent search baselines (ALNS, tabu search, GA, simulated annealing, iterated local search, and GRASP) by 6.68-8.35%, where outputs later than 100 ms receive zero utility. All 750 Full runs in the internal suite returned feasible allocations, and none exceeded 100 ms. Separating mandatory output construction from optional refinement lets spare computation time improve the allocation without endangering the incumbent. The open-source implementation supports independent reproduction.
papers.translated_summary: 短间隔无线调度器必须在每次执行截止时间之前返回完整、可行的波束与资源分配方案，迟交或无效的输出在当前控制周期内不产生任何效用。搜索时间更长可能增加传输流量，但也可能错过截止时间，或只留下一个不可行的中间解。我们提出可行性保持的事务式精化方法（Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement，FPTR），它始终保留一个经过验证的可行分配方案，即现任解。每个精化阶段构建一个独立的候选解，并保持现任解不变。候选解只有在完整、在其阶段截止时间之前通过可行性验证器、并且严格改善目标函数时，才会替换现任解；否则被丢弃。四个精化阶段采用该规则：缓冲区感知的资源选择、兼容组（compatibility-group，CG）用户共享、基于剩余需求的波束掩码重建，以及两个资源的联合重新分配。在150个固定合成实例上，完整流水线（Full）相比轻量级波束优先参考方案平均提升流量3.83%，相比其Base构造器提升1.79%。在具有匹配输入的独立测试集中，Full相比六个独立搜索基线（ALNS、禁忌搜索、GA、模拟退火、迭代局部搜索和GRASP）高出6.68–8.35%，其中晚于100 ms的输出获得零效用。内部测试集中全部750次Full运行均返回可行分配，且均未超过100 ms。将强制输出构造与可选精化解耦，使空闲计算时间能够改善分配而不危及现任解。开源实现支持独立复现。

papers.title: Risk-Sensitive Non-Parametric and Kernel Bandits
papers.translated_title: 风险敏感的非参数与核bandits
papers.author: Devdan Dey
papers.summary: We study non-parametric bandits in which arms are evaluated using Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) rather than expected reward. We consider continuous action spaces with arm-dependent noise and propose Non-Parametric CPT Bandits ($\mathtt{NPCB}$), an optimistic algorithm that decouples mean estimation from CPT-based decision-making. We prove CPT regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$, where $\dim_E$ is the Eluder dimension of the function class $\mathcal F$, $T$ is the time horizon, and $N$ is its covering number in the sup norm. This matches the order-wise regret of classical non-parametric bandits, showing that CPT risk sensitivity incurs no additional order-wise regret cost. We extend $\mathtt{NPCB}$ to unknown noise CDFs, retaining the known-CDF mean-learning term and adding a CDF-learning cost governed by a distributional Eluder dimension. We also study Kernel-CPT bandits and obtain information-gain-based regret bounds for a broad range of kernels, matching the corresponding risk-neutral kernel rates up to logarithmic factors.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究非参数 bandit 问题，其中臂的评估采用累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory, CPT）而非期望奖励。我们考虑具有臂相关噪声的连续动作空间，并提出非参数 CPT Bandit（$\mathtt{NPCB}$），一种将均值估计与基于 CPT 的决策解耦的乐观算法。我们证明 CPT 遗憾界为 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$，其中 $\dim_E$ 是函数类 $\mathcal F$ 的 Eluder 维数，$T$ 是时间跨度，$N$ 是其在 sup 范数下的覆盖数。该结果与经典非参数 bandit 的阶数级遗憾相匹配，表明 CPT 风险敏感性不会带来额外的阶数级遗憾代价。我们将 $\mathtt{NPCB}$ 扩展到未知噪声 CDF 的情形，保留已知 CDF 的均值学习项，并加入由分布 Eluder 维数控制的 CDF 学习代价。我们还研究 Kernel-CPT bandit，并针对一大类核获得基于信息增益的遗憾界，在至多对数因子的意义下与相应的风险中性核速率相匹配。

papers.title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
papers.translated_title: 模型合并不需要统一的LoRA秩
papers.author: Zirong Xie
papers.summary: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. Merging keeps only a fixed share of the pooled spectral components, and methods that choose them by size discard many that would have reduced loss. They also tend to discard the same expert: the instruction adapter has the smallest singular values, so it is dropped almost entirely and IFEval falls by 16 to 25 pp. Choosing components by their effect on loss instead keeps all three experts, and leaves accuracy nearly flat across an 8$\times$ rank range (0.7 pp, against 6.7 pp for TIES at 4B scale). Rank can therefore be chosen per expert whenever the merge operator does not select by magnitude.
papers.translated_summary: 模型合并将分别微调的专家整合为单一模型而无需重新训练。标准做法是以相同的LoRA秩训练每个专家，这即使每个领域各有其最佳秩，也将秩的选择跨专家耦合在一起。我们表明这种耦合是合并方法的属性，而非合并本身的属性。我们在三个领域（数学、指令遵循、多语言）以四个秩和三种模型规模训练了36个专家，然后以统一秩和每个领域各自的最佳秩用六种方法进行合并。给专家不同的秩对平均法和基于效用的选择法毫无损失，并使其多领域准确率提升最多1.8个百分点，而冲突解决方法则表现不一致，可能损失最多4个百分点。这种分化有一个简单的原因。合并只保留池化谱成分的固定份额，而按大小选择这些成分的方法会丢弃许多本可降低损失的成分。它们还倾向于丢弃同一个专家：指令适配器具有最小的奇异值，因此几乎被完全丢弃，IFEval下降16至25个百分点。相反，按成分对损失的影响来选择成分会保留所有三个专家，并使准确率在8倍秩范围内几乎持平（0.7个百分点，而TIES在4B规模下为6.7个百分点）。因此，只要合并算子不按幅度进行选择，秩就可以按专家分别选择。

papers.title: Object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers: architecture, representation, and acquisition shortcuts
papers.translated_title: 小数据天文图像分类器的对象无关评估：架构、表示与采集捷径
papers.author: Eraldo Pereira Marinho
papers.summary: Reported performance in small astronomical image datasets can reflect object reuse, field-of-view differences, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived properties as well as astronomical morphology. We designed \dataset{} to measure these effects in a four-class task comprising galaxies, globular clusters, nebulae, and open clusters. The dataset contains 370 catalogue-supported physical objects, each represented by three Digitised Sky Survey FITS bands, and uses a group-constrained split of 222 training, 75 validation, and 73 test objects. We compared a custom CNN--Transformer trained from scratch with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 under an adaptive full-field representation, a common angular field, and two central-region-masked controls, using three fixed seeds. In the one-pass object-independent test, mean balanced accuracy on the adaptive view was $0.773\pm0.014$, $0.874\pm0.054$, and $0.866\pm0.023$ for the custom model, ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16, respectively. No primary architecture contrast rejected its null after Holm correction; ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 differed by 0.007 balanced-accuracy points (95\% cluster-bootstrap interval $[-0.048,0.062]$). Controls based on acquisition and catalogue metadata reached 0.721--0.735, and central-region-masked adaptive views reached 0.731--0.800. These results demonstrate generalisation to unseen physical objects, but also show that image context, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived object properties carry substantial class information. In this regime, high accuracy cannot be interpreted as evidence that a classifier learned target morphology, and the comparison does not isolate architecture from pretraining.
papers.translated_summary: 在小天文图像数据集上报告的的性能可能反映对象复用、视场差异、采集设置和目录衍生属性，以及天文形态。我们设计了\dataset{}来测量这些效应，任务为四分类，包括星系、球状星团、星云和疏散星团。该数据集包含370个目录支持的物理对象，每个对象由三个数字化巡天FITS波段表示，并采用组约束划分：222个训练对象、75个验证对象和73个测试对象。我们在自适应全视场表示、共同角视场和两个中心区域掩蔽对照下，使用三个固定种子，将从零开始训练的自定义CNN--Transformer与ImageNet预训练的ResNet-50和ViT-B/16进行比较。在单次对象独立测试中，自适应视图上的平均平衡准确率对于自定义模型、ResNet-50和ViT-B/16分别为$0.773\pm0.014$、$0.874\pm0.054$和$0.866\pm0.023$。经Holm校正后，没有主要架构对比拒绝其原假设；ResNet-50和ViT-B/16相差0.007个平衡准确率点（95\%聚类自助区间$[-0.048,0.062]$）。基于采集和目录元数据的对照达到0.721--0.735，中心区域掩蔽的自适应视图达到0.731--0.800。这些结果证明了对未见物理对象的泛化能力，但也表明图像上下文、采集设置和目录衍生的对象属性携带了大量类别信息。在这种情况下，高准确率不能解释为分类器学习了目标形态的证据，且该比较未将架构与预训练隔离开来。

papers.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
papers.translated_title: 多轮强化学习在LLM智能体中究竟真正改进了什么？
papers.author: Kejian Zhu
papers.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
papers.translated_summary: 多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在长时程任务上表现优异，但其性能增益对交互约束高度敏感。我们通过 Pass@(K,T) 在采样广度 K 和交互深度 T 上进行评估，结果表明轨迹级 RL 优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，当预算收紧时显著衰减。此外，智能体 RL 并非一致地提升单步决策质量，其优势集中于错误恢复与长时程韧性。为缓解这种预算依赖性带来的部署风险，我们对过程监督信号的收益与局限进行了初步讨论，并引入 BudgetMix RL 作为替代方案，在训练过程中变化交互预算。实验表明，BudgetMix RL 在多样化的执行设置下均能取得稳健性能。项目页面：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

papers.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
papers.translated_title: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的智能体组合检索
papers.author: Jyotin Goel
papers.summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过在一个由语料库构建的知识图谱上进行检索来回答问题。然而，检索策略是围绕其自身构建流程所产生的结构来设计的，而这些策略能否在构建方式改变后依然有效，却鲜有测试。我们研究这种跨构建的可移植性：即一种检索流程，在不依赖特定构建模式的模式、关系名称或重新调参的情况下，当图以不同方式构建时，是否仍能保持有效。我们提出 ArcRAG，它在推理时归纳出一个查询局部的图接口（即从问题所提及实体可达的节点标签、关系描述符和属性键），针对该接口规划多跳遍历，并以 Cypher 形式执行和修复这些遍历。我们将 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 和 TriviaQA 各语料库分别构建为模式引导图（带类型节点、封闭关系集、来源溯源）和开放信息抽取图（无类型节点、自由文本关系），且检索器的配置在两者之间保持固定。我们与一个构建无关的 Direct-Cypher 智能体进行比较，在两种图族上分别针对重试和通过预算对每个阶段进行消融，并与先前 GraphRAG 系统所报告的结果进行比较，这些系统大多将检索与自身的图构建一同设计。在两种构建方式下，我们发现检索无需与图协同设计：查询时接口归纳使得构建无关的检索器在构建方式改变时仍保持有效，尽管构建方式仍然影响绝对准确率。

papers.title: Towards Early Warning of Real-World Vulnerabilities: An Evidence-Aware Decoupled Method for CVSS Vector Prediction Based on Unstructured Disclosures
papers.translated_title: 面向现实世界漏洞的早期预警：一种基于非结构化披露的、证据感知的解耦式CVSS向量预测方法
papers.author: Jianhong Ma
papers.summary: Early assessment of Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) vectors from Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) can reduce the delay between initial public disclosure and official National Vulnerability Database (NVD) scoring. Existing predictors, trained mainly on standardized late-stage descriptions, degrade on noisy and incomplete pre-NVD reports. We introduce PARSE, a vulnerability-disclosure lifecycle model, and VPre, an early assessment framework built on two-level Evidence-Aware Decoupling. Decoupling Level I, Security-Evidence Screening, separates security-relevant evidence from noisy early reports at the report and sentence levels. Decoupling Level II, Evidence-Matched Routing, decouples the prediction task of the eight CVSS metrics into a scattered-evidence class and an explicit-evidence class based on validation-set measurements, matching each with a targeted predictor: large-language-model reasoning for the former, lightweight supervised classification for the latter. On the 851-report held-out test split of the 5,581-report VPre-Bench, VPre achieves a mean absolute error of 0.7239 -- 44.7% below the reproduced BERT-Small-NVD early-transfer baseline; paired timestamps across the full benchmark show an average 38-day lead before official scoring (observed range 21-60 days). Under the 38:1 PARSE-Triage noise setting, STDU's report-level screening reaches 0.98 precision, 1.00 recall, and 0.99 F1. Controlled ablations support the contributions of both decoupling levels.
papers.translated_summary: 对来自开源情报（OSINT）的通用漏洞评分系统（CVSS）向量的早期评估，可以缩短初始公开披露与官方国家漏洞数据库（NVD）评分之间的延迟。现有预测器主要基于标准化的后期描述进行训练，在嘈杂且不完整的NVD前报告上性能下降。我们引入PARSE，一个漏洞披露生命周期模型，以及VPre，一个基于两级证据感知解耦的早期评估框架。解耦第一级，安全证据筛选，在报告和句子两个层面将安全相关证据与嘈杂的早期报告分离。解耦第二级，证据匹配路由，基于验证集测量将八个CVSS指标的预测任务解耦为分散证据类和显式证据类，并为每一类匹配针对性的预测器：前者采用大语言模型推理，后者采用轻量级监督分类。在5,581份报告的VPre-Bench的851份报告留出测试划分上，VPre实现了0.7239的平均绝对误差——比复现的BERT-Small-NVD早期迁移基线低44.7%；整个基准上的配对时间戳显示，在官方评分前平均领先38天（观测范围为21-60天）。在38:1的PARSE-Triage噪声设置下，STDU的报告级筛选达到0.98精确率、1.00召回率和0.99 F1。受控消融实验支持两个解耦级别的贡献。

papers.title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
papers.translated_title: 对齐税是有等级的：在长度归一化DPO与SFT保留下的任务选择性能力损失
papers.author: Ye Yuan
papers.summary: Setting. This is an empirical characterization study; we propose no new method and run no comparisons against alternative objectives. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B with sparse LoRA and length-normalized DPO plus an SFT retention term (the RPO objective) on structured financial-filing tasks, and track downstream capability as the implicit reward margin grows to $\sim 7$ $β$-scaled units (nf4 training; $\sim 3$ under fp16 measurement on the unquantized base). Question. Does margin growth degrade capability uniformly across tasks, or selectively? Findings. In a pre-registered study (8 seeds, 6 unseen at freeze) with artifact-aware scoring and TOST equivalence testing, the alignment tax is graded and task-selective: extraction is preserved ($Δ= -0.55$ pts, equivalent at $\pm5$ pts), json loses little ($Δ= -3.52$ pts, equivalence fails on a clustered item-level interval), and router degrades severely ($Δ= -30$ pts). Router's loss concentrates in a margin 1-3 damage window containing a transient format-break spike. The margin is accounted for almost entirely ($\geq 96\%$) by suppression of rejected completions, with chosen reward approximately flat, consistent with the retention term anchoring it; we do not attribute the behavioral damage to any single gradient channel. Gold-logp deflation is task-selective (extraction $-0.15$, json $-1.04$, router $-1.47$ nats/token under fp16), with gold selectively protected relative to incorrect controls on extraction (8/8 seeds). QLoRA reward margins differ up to $3.4\times$ between nf4 training and unquantized fp16 measurement, with an axis-dependent gap. Scope. Length-normalized rewards with SFT retention, sparse LoRA on 8/32 layers, one 4B model, easily-separable synthetic preferences, three structured tasks. A no-retention control and a measured format-alignment metric are left to future work.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。这是一项实证性刻画研究；我们不提出新方法，也不与替代目标进行对比。我们在结构化财务申报任务上，使用稀疏 LoRA 和长度归一化 DPO 加 SFT 保持项（即 RPO 目标）微调 Qwen3.5-4B，并随着隐式奖励间隔增长至约 7 个 β 缩放单位（nf4 训练；在未量化基座的 fp16 测量下约为 3）跟踪下游能力。问题。间隔增长是均匀地降低各任务能力，还是选择性地降低？发现。在一项预注册研究（8 个种子，冻结时 6 个未见）中，采用工件感知评分和 TOST 等价性检验，对齐税是分级的且具有任务选择性：抽取能力得以保持（Δ= -0.55 分，在 ±5 分处等价），json 损失较小（Δ= -3.52 分，在聚类项目级区间上等价性不成立），router 严重退化（Δ= -30 分）。router 的损失集中在包含瞬态格式中断尖峰的间隔 1-3 损害窗口内。该间隔几乎完全（≥ 96%）由对被拒绝补全的抑制所解释，被选中奖励大致持平，这与保持项对其锚定一致；我们不将行为损害归因于任何单一梯度通道。Gold-logp 通缩具有任务选择性（在 fp16 下，抽取 -0.15、json -1.04、router -1.47 nats/token），并且在抽取任务上，gold 相对于错误对照被选择性保护（8/8 种子）。QLoRA 奖励间隔在 nf4 训练与未量化 fp16 测量之间相差最多 3.4 倍，且存在轴依赖的差距。范围。带 SFT 保持的长度归一化奖励、8/32 层上的稀疏 LoRA、一个 4B 模型、易于分离的合成偏好、三个结构化任务。无保持对照和已测量的格式对齐指标留待未来工作。

papers.title: A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
papers.translated_title: 一个统一CT解读与分割的三维基础模型
papers.author: Yulu Xie
papers.summary: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.
papers.translated_summary: 放射科医生解读计算机断层扫描（CT）时，需要同时判断某个征象代表什么以及它位于三维（3D）解剖结构中的何处。然而，CT模型一直将CT解读与3D分割视为彼此独立的任务，导致文本征象在空间上无法验证，也忽视了临床理解与空间感知之间潜在的协同作用。在此，我们提出HoloCT，这是一个通用的3D基础模型，通过联合建模全容积上下文和细粒度解剖细节，将CT解读与体素级分割统一起来，并提供3D掩码作为证据。我们构建了HoloDATA，包含来自73个公开数据集和六个临床队列的195，921例CT扫描，以及620万条指令对话和280万对CT-掩码配对。在涵盖分割、病灶筛查、视觉问答和报告生成等346项任务（涉及61个内部数据集和12个外部数据集）上，HoloCT优于专科模型和基础模型。在来自五家医院的11，455例临床CT扫描的多中心验证中，HoloCT在病灶分割和报告生成方面分别以18.2分和15.3分优于竞争模型。在筛查甲状腺肿瘤和结肠病灶方面，其平均准确率达到85.1%，在一项回顾性阅片者研究中超过了全部四位参与的放射科医生。进一步分析揭示了双向的语义-空间协同：语言引导的分割能够描绘未见过的解剖结构和病灶以及弥漫性自由文本征象，以22.1分优于领先方法；而提示模型在输出文本的同时生成相应的3D掩码，则显著提升了判读性能。HoloCT表明，临床理解与空间感知可以在单一基础模型内共同学习，并为更准确、更可靠的CT分析提供了一条路径。

papers.title: How many sorted projections determine n points in k dimensions?
papers.translated_title: 在k维空间中，有多少个排序投影能确定n个点？
papers.author: Christopher Gorham Lester
papers.summary: Let $d_1,\dots,d_m$ be directions in $\mathbb{R}^k$, where $k\ge 2$. A multiset $X$ of $n$ points of $\mathbb{R}^k$ projects to the $m$ multisets of numbers $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$, or equivalently to the $m$ sorted lists of these numbers. How many directions are needed for these projections to determine every multiset of $n$ points? Two simple bounds are known in every dimension: more than $(k-1)\log_2 n$ directions are always needed, and $(k-1)n+1$ directions in general position always suffice. In the plane much more is known: Matousek, Privetivy and Skovron showed that almost every choice of $O(\log n \log\log n)$ directions suffices. Whether anything similar holds in higher dimensions was left open by Dym, Wellershoff, Tsoukanis, Levy and Balan. We observe that two lemmas of Hair and Sahai, proved for list recovery of random linear codes, answer that question, and by tightening their argument we show that in every dimension almost every choice of $(4k-2)\ln(2n)\ln(k\log_2 2n)+k+1$ directions suffices. For $k\le 10$ this beats the linear bound once $n$ is larger than about 100: for example, 144 directions suffice for multisets of 1000 points in the plane, and an exact computation lowers this to 133. Letting some of the random blocks in their argument fail removes a factor $\log k$: almost every choice of $O(k\log n\log\log n)$ directions suffices, uniformly in $k$ and $n$. We also show that $2k-1$ directions never determine three points, so that the logarithmic lower bound is not tight; that every $m$ directions in the plane fail on some pair of multisets of size $O(1.78^m)$, improving the bound $O(1.80^m)$ of Matousek, Privetivy and Skovron; and that for each $k$, $m$ and $n$, either almost every choice of $m$ directions works or almost none does.
papers.translated_summary: 设 $d_1,\dots,d_m$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^k$ 中的方向，其中 $k\ge 2$。一个由 $\mathbb{R}^k$ 中 $n$ 个点构成的多重集 $X$ 投影为 $m$ 个数值多重集 $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$，或等价地投影为这些数的 $m$ 个排序列表。要使这些投影确定每一个 $n$ 点的多重集，需要多少个方向？在每个维度上已知两个简单的界：总是需要多于 $(k-1)\log_2 n$ 个方向，而处于一般位置的 $(k-1)n+1$ 个方向总是足够的。在平面中已知的结果要多得多：Matousek、Privetivy 和 Skovron 证明了几乎每一组 $O(\log n \log\log n)$ 个方向的选择都足够。更高维中是否有类似的结果，被 Dym、Wellershoff、Tsoukanis、Levy 和 Balan 留作未解决的问题。我们注意到，Hair 和 Sahai 为随机线性码的列表恢复所证明的两个引理回答了这个问题，并且通过收紧他们的论证，我们证明在每个维度上，几乎每一组 $(4k-2)\ln(2n)\ln(k\log_2 2n)+k+1$ 个方向的选择都足够。对于 $k\le 10$，一旦 $n$ 大于约 100，这就胜过了线性界：例如，对于平面中 1000 个点的多重集，144 个方向就足够，而精确计算将此降低到 133。让他们论证中的一些随机块失败，可以去掉一个因子 $\log k$：几乎每一组 $O(k\log n\log\log n)$ 个方向的选择都足够，且关于 $k$ 和 $n$ 一致。我们还证明 $2k-1$ 个方向永远不能确定三个点，因此对数下界并不紧；平面中每 $m$ 个方向都会在某对大小为 $O(1.78^m)$ 的多重集上失败，改进了 Matousek、Privetivy 和 Skovron 的界 $O(1.80^m)$；并且对于每个 $k$、$m$ 和 $n$，要么几乎每一组 $m$ 个方向的选择都有效，要么几乎没有一个有效。
